app.name: AI AgentHub
app.tagline: Find, configure and run specialist agents for professional tasks — with control over what they can do.

landing.title: Agents that execute tasks — under your control
landing.subtitle: AI AgentHub is a platform to discover, install, configure, run and share task-oriented agents, with permissions, history, authorized tools and human approval.
landing.p1Body: Every agent runs with an explicit whitelist of tools. Nothing outside it is possible.
landing.p2Body: Every execution, approval and change is recorded so you can see what happened and who decided.
landing.p3Body: Sensitive or irreversible actions wait for an explicit confirmation from a person.
landing.statusNote: The agent marketplace is not available yet. This is an early foundation release.
